in_hebrew.name: Fahy
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Arising or Maker
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fahy הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Irish word 'Faith', meaning 'arising' or 'maker'. In Christian contexts, it could be associated with the belief in the Creator God.

in_greek.name: Fahy
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Arising or Maker
in_greek.long_meaning: Fahy είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Irish word 'Faith', meaning 'arising' or 'maker'. In Christian contexts, it could be associated with the belief in the Creator God.

in_latin.name: Fahy
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Arising or Maker
in_latin.long_meaning: Fahy est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Irish word 'Faith', meaning 'arising' or 'maker'. In Christian contexts, it could be associated with the belief in the Creator God.
